# Shared download network-gate cases.
#
# Replayed by both implementations, so they cannot drift apart:
#   - native/linthra_core/src/download_gate_cases_test.rs (Rust)
#   - test/core/services/download_gate_cases_test.dart (Dart)
#
# One case per line, fields separated by a single TAB. `#` starts a comment.
#
#   <network>  <allow mobile data>  <decision>
#
# network:  wifi | mobile | unknown | offline
# decision: allowed | needsWifi | offline

wifi	false	allowed
wifi	true	allowed
mobile	false	needsWifi
mobile	true	allowed
unknown	false	needsWifi
unknown	true	allowed
offline	false	offline
offline	true	offline
